baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct joining focus words 1 and 2 to the source phrase at words 3-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse foregrounds an effected delivery rather than the bare existence of a text: a written object is made to reach its recipients from a named transcendent source.

activation_trace.role: Supplies caused reaching from a source and makes delivery the foregrounded event.
Supplies the written object that undergoes the delivery.
Supplies the worship relation that makes the stated origin an authority claim, not a geographic source.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely labels a book and names its author.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents the Book as an intentionally effected arrival from the One to whom worship is due.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 and the final source title at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book can be heard simultaneously as joined composition and fixed determination. Its textual joining is therefore not ornamental arrangement but an order capable of obligating and deciding, with the final title qualifying that order as exact rather than accidental.

activation_trace.role: Supplies joining of parts and lets the Book function as a composed whole.
Adds fixation and obligation, giving the composed whole normative force.
Supplies exact construction and firmness as the quality governing that binding order.

changed_reading.before: Book means only a volume containing writing.
changed_reading.after: Book is a joined textual order that fixes a consequential determination with internal exactness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verbal noun at focus word 1 in relation to the composed Book and the final title.
baseline_models.mechanism: Delivery may include assigning each element its fitting station. On this reading, revelation is not only motion from above but deliberate arrangement: a joined Book is set into the rank, sequence, and human situation appropriate to it.

activation_trace.role: Supplies deliberate assignment to a fitting station and turns descent into arrangement.
Supplies joined parts whose relations can be deliberately ordered.
Makes fitting placement an exact construction rather than arbitrary positioning.

changed_reading.after: Descent also names the precise placement and ordering by which the Book reaches its fitting station.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired source titles at focus words 5-6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two titles form a control relation: overcoming power is paired with right-knowing exactness. The source can make the delivery effective, yet its force is neither blind nor arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Supplies overcoming force and makes the delivery effectual rather than merely advisory.
Supplies right-knowing judgment as the intelligence directing that force.
Adds precision and firmness, excluding uncontrolled power from the source profile.

changed_reading.before: The closing names are detachable honorifics.
changed_reading.after: The closing pair specifies the delivery's mechanism as effective power governed by exact knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The less expected reception branch of focus word 1, attached to the Book at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The delivery term can evoke what a host has already made ready for an arriving guest. The Book may therefore be carried, provisionally, as a prepared reception offered to the one who receives it, not only as an object sent downward.

activation_trace.role: Supplies readiness for an arrival and recasts delivery as an offered reception.
Keeps the hospitable activation attached to the actual written Book rather than an independent theme.

changed_reading.before: The Book is only cargo transferred to recipients.
changed_reading.after: The Book can also be heard as a reception already prepared for those who arrive to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first calls heavens, earth, created life, and recurring weather signs, then speaks of those signs as recited in truth. That crossover activates the Book's joined composition as a readable ordering of dispersed evidence: world and discourse become adjacent fields of signs without having to become identical objects.

activation_trace.role: Supplies composition by joining and lets dispersed signs be read as an ordered whole.
Marks the cosmic field as visibly indicative rather than mute background.
Repeats visible indication on both sides of the recitation claim and links the fields.
Supplies following in sequence, making recitation an ordered traversal of signs.
Grounds that traversal in correspondence with reality rather than free association.

structural_cues: 45:3-5 moves from cosmic scope to embodied life to recurring weather before 45:6 gathers the sequence with a deictic reference.
The same sign noun occurs in the created scenes and in the recitation statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated signs, a gathering deictic, and recitation in truth; I supply the arrow that the Book orders world-signs into a followable reading. A live alternative keeps created signs and recited signs parallel but distinct.

changed_reading.before: The descended Book is a bounded written object set beside the world.
changed_reading.after: The descended Book can organize the world itself as a sequenced field of readable signs while remaining a written discourse.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concrete descent from the sky arrives as apportioned sustenance, revives land after loss of life, and works with turning winds. This supplies a material causal analogue for the focus delivery: revelation is distributed provision whose success is measured by enlivening effects, not merely by arrival.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed reading in effected delivery of the Book.
Keeps the life-bearing analogy attached to the written revelation.
Repeats caused delivery in a visible sky-to-earth process and supplies the analogue's first step.
Identifies the descending material as sustaining provision rather than neutral precipitation.
Supplies revived earth as the observable effect of successful delivery.
Supplies unanimated land as the prior condition that delivery reverses.
Adds managed variation from state to state to the delivery process.
Supplies moving air as the distributed carrier accompanying transformation.

structural_cues: 45:5 explicitly orders descent, provision, revival, prior death, and redirected winds as one causal scene.
The focus delivery root recurs in that scene before any later dispute about hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the physical chain from descent through provision to revived ground; I supply the analogical arrow from that chain to the Book's effect on recipients. A live alternative treats the rain scene only as independent evidence of divine power.

changed_reading.before: The Book's descent is complete once information reaches an audience.
changed_reading.after: The Book's descent is patterned as distributed provision whose characteristic work is to bring receptive ground to life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing is followed by recitation, persistence, arrogance, and performed non-hearing; the sequence returns near the end as recitation followed by arrogance. Delivery therefore becomes a diagnostic encounter. Its ordered sound calls for following, and refusal exposes a will that can hear acoustically while blocking compliance.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the encounter in the written Book that is made audible through recitation.
Supplies corrective restraint as a purpose that resistant reception can reject.
Distinguishes compliant understanding from mere acoustic exposure and makes the doubled hearing diagnostic.
Supplies sequential following within recitation and sharpens what resistant hearing fails to do.
Supplies fixed resolve and turns nonresponse into maintained opposition.
Supplies self-magnification as the posture that prevents hearing from becoming following.
Replays the recitation side of the encounter at the judgment-facing end of the surah.
Replays self-magnification as the decisive response to that recitation.

structural_cues: 45:8 places persistence after hearing with an explicit temporal step and then compares the hearer to one who never heard.
45:31 restates recitation followed by arrogance in retrospective accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the hearing-recitation-persistence sequence and its later replay; I supply the arrow that delivery reveals and can harden a receiver's stance. A live alternative is that the sequence only reports an opposition already complete before recitation.

changed_reading.before: Descent makes information available and leaves reception outside the verse's mechanism.
changed_reading.after: Descent initiates an encounter in which audible recitation tests whether hearing will become following or maintained refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Book and judgment are given together, yet clear knowledge is followed by divergence driven by rivalry. The addressee is then placed upon a disclosed way and commanded to follow it rather than competing inclinations. This activates focus descent as proper placement and the Book as an enacted route, while denying that clarity mechanically produces social unity.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in deliberate placement at a fitting station.
Supplies the Book as a fixed normative gift within the historical sequence.
Places adjudicative judgment beside the Book and makes its order publicly consequential.
Supplies parties taking divergent paths and shows that received knowledge can be displaced socially.
Supplies boundary-crossing rivalry as the motive that turns knowledge into division.
Supplies an exposed point of access and lets the prescribed way function as a life-bearing route.
Supplies tracking behind a lead and makes placement effective only through enacted following.

structural_cues: 45:16 coordinates Book, judgment, and prophecy as gifts before 45:17 narrates post-knowledge division.
45:18 answers that division with placement on a way and a contrast between two objects of following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, knowledge, rivalry, placement, and following; I supply the arrow that proper placement must be enacted and can be socially displaced. A live alternative treats the historical division only as a warning external to the focus descent.

changed_reading.before: Precise placement of the Book guarantees a single settled reception.
changed_reading.after: The Book is precisely placed as a route to follow, but knowledgeable recipients can still leave that route through rivalry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse is characterized as inward sight, guidance, and mercy, but a person can install desire in the place of deity; hearing, heart, and sight then become sealed or covered. The focus origin phrase therefore becomes an allegiance claim about who governs perception and judgment, not merely an attribution of authorship.

activation_trace.role: Anchors divine source in the worship relation whose authority desire contests.
Supplies inward discernment as a function of the delivered discourse.
Supplies gentle direction toward a true course rather than coercive information transfer.
Adds responsive care as the intended mode of guidance.
Supplies deliberate adoption and makes the counter-authority installed rather than accidental.
The repeated worship vocabulary sets an adopted object of devotion against the divine source.
Supplies inward inclination as the rival governor of interpretation.
Supplies a secured barrier that converts rival allegiance into blocked reception.
Supplies an overlying cover and completes the loss of perceptual access.

structural_cues: 45:20 names three recipient-facing functions before 45:23 presents a counter-allegiance and three blocked faculties.
The divine name occurs on both sides of the adopted deity construction in 45:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies insight, guidance, mercy, adopted desire, and blocked faculties; I supply the arrow that the focus source claim contests interpretive allegiance. A live alternative reads the origin phrase only as provenance and confines the allegiance issue to 45:23.

changed_reading.before: From God identifies where the Book came from.
changed_reading.after: From God also demands that divine authority, rather than adopted desire, govern how the Book is perceived and judged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context rejects a judgment that makes harmful and faithful lives equal, then links creation in truth to repayment of every self for what it acquired without misplacement. The final focus title expands from an attribute of the sender into an architecture of differentiated, exact accountability.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the title in adjudication between parties and outcomes.
Turns the title's adjudicative potential into an explicit criticism of false equivalence.
Supplies correspondence with reality as the ground of created moral order.
Supplies measured return of an act and makes judgment causally responsive.
Individualizes the accounting at the level of each self.
Supplies acquired action as the input to differentiated return.
Its negation excludes placing an outcome in the wrong time or position and defines exact justice.

structural_cues: 45:21 contrasts two moral cohorts in life and death before evaluating the judgment that equates them.
45:22 moves from truthful creation to each self, its acquisition, and a negated passive injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected equivalence and individualized recompense; I supply the arrow that these clauses unfold the focus title's governing logic. A live alternative keeps the title as general wisdom rather than specifically judicial wisdom.

changed_reading.before: The final title says only that the source possesses wisdom.
changed_reading.after: The final title anticipates a precise order that distinguishes unlike lives and returns each acquisition without misplacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Communities are called to their book, and the next verse describes a book that indicates against them in truth because actions were being copied. This activates a second live sense for the focus Book: alongside revelation, it can foreshadow a forensic record that preserves deeds and becomes active evidence.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the alternate reading in a written fixation with consequential force.
Makes the summoned book a fixed determination relevant to judgment.
Supplies an actual written record rather than a free-floating metaphor of memory.
Lets the record function as manifest indication even without treating paper literally as a mouth.
Requires the record's indication to correspond to what occurred.
Supplies copying from one written register to another as the preservation mechanism.
Supplies intentional deeds as the content preserved by the record.

structural_cues: 45:28 moves every community from kneeling to being summoned to its book before announcing recompense for action.
45:29 gives the book a truth-bearing evidentiary function and follows it with an explanation of ongoing copying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the summoned book, its evidentiary indication, and copied actions; I supply the backward activation that the definite focus Book can carry a forensic-register resonance alongside revelation. A live alternative treats the two books as distinct objects linked only by vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The focus Book can only be the discourse delivered for present guidance.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be revelation, the focus Book can foreshadow the truth-bearing record in which received guidance and human action meet.

context_deltas.mechanism: One cohort is brought inside mercy and named successful; another reaches a fixed refuge in fire. Those opposed destinations activate the focus delivery's reception branch: the Book may be an offered welcome whose reception eventually resolves into where its hearers are received.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the exploratory model in readiness for an arriving recipient.
Supplies crossing into an interior and turns reception into an entered condition.
Characterizes the positive interior as active care rather than mere location.
Supplies beneficial escape as the result of entering that reception.
Supplies a gathering refuge and establishes the opposed destination.
Identifies the opposed refuge through burning fire rather than hospitable care.

structural_cues: 45:30 and 45:34 use inward or refuge constructions for opposite outcomes.
The outcomes follow repeated scenes of how recitation was received.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry into mercy and an opposed refuge; I supply the arrow back to the focus reception branch and treat response to the Book as determining reception. A live alternative is that the destinations are consequences with no hospitable resonance in the opening noun.

changed_reading.before: Prepared reception is only a lexical curiosity in the focus delivery term.
changed_reading.after: The context lets that curiosity persist as a bifurcating reception: the delivered Book offers entry, while response shapes the destination in which the hearer is finally received.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promised time is asserted as true, denied as uncertain, then followed by the appearance of acquired harms, their encompassing return, a forgotten encounter, and inability to exit. This activates the focus Book's fixed-decree sense and the severe-event branch of descent: what first arrives as discourse later arrives as realized determination.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed reading in a determination fixed before its consequences become visible.
Supplies the form-distant possibility that descent culminates as a severe event arriving upon a people.
Supplies a promised occurrence bounded by an appointed time.
Supplies emergence into visibility and marks the transition from denied claim to manifest result.
Supplies harmful arrival together with enclosure, giving realized decree spatial force.
Supplies reciprocal abandonment and links prior neglect to present outcome.
Supplies the coming face-to-face that denial had postponed.
Its negation removes outward passage and completes the enclosing realization.

structural_cues: 45:32-35 orders claim, uncertainty, manifestation, enclosure, reciprocal neglect, and no exit.
Root ع ت ب at 45:35 word 16 has no branch inventory; it is used only structurally as the denied opportunity to regain favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointed promise, manifestation, enclosure, encounter, and no exit; I supply the arrow that realized judgment is a later mode of the opening fixed delivery. A live alternative keeps descent exclusively revelatory and judgment only as its consequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus delivery arrives only as a communicative text.
changed_reading.after: The text can also announce a fixed determination whose denied content later arrives as visible and enclosing event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close assigns praise and lordship across heavens, earth, and all worlds, then repeats the two focus titles after universal greatness. The repetition turns the opening titles into a frame around every intervening scene: delivery, natural order, guidance, resistance, and judgment all occur within one domain of governed power.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the opening side of the frame in overcoming power.
Anchors the opening side of the frame in right-knowing judgment.
Supplies the evaluative response opposite blame and directs it to the source.
Supplies repeated sovereignty across the three expanding domains.
Supplies the upper cosmic domain included under that sovereignty.
Supplies the lower counterpart and completes the vertical scope of the frame.
Supplies universal greatness immediately before the repeated titles.
Repeats overcoming power at the closing side of the frame.
Repeats right-knowing judgment as the final control on the framed power.

structural_cues: 45:37 repeats the final two lexical items of 45:2 in the same order.
45:36-37 expands from named cosmic domains to universal greatness immediately before that repetition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact title repetition and expanding domain language; I supply the framing arrow that the close sends the intervening mechanisms back into the opening. A live alternative treats the repetition as doxological closure without retrospective force.

changed_reading.before: The focus titles describe only the immediate source of one textual delivery.
changed_reading.after: The repeated titles frame the entire surah, making the Book's source the ruler and exact governor of every cosmic and judicial process displayed between them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bridle image is materially remote from an abstract divine title, so this should be rendered as a controlled analogy, not a lexical replacement. It remains valid because it is directly anchored in the focus title's branch and is activated by commanded motion, following, and the counter-motion of desire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pairing of overcoming force at focus word 5 with the restraint branch at focus word 6.

activation_trace.role: Supplies force capable of overcoming resistance.
Supplies a concrete restraint that channels powerful motion rather than abolishing it.
Supplies directed movement through a medium as the context's kinetic activation.
Supplies a course maintained by tracking a lead.
Supplies inward drift as the live alternative to governed direction.

changed_reading.before: Power and wisdom are two adjacent abstractions.
changed_reading.after: The pair can be pictured as force under reins: revelation moves effectively, but its course is governed against the drift of desire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treating textual composition as a vessel is cross-domain and should be marked as a material analogy, not an identification of the Book with a ship. It remains anchored in the focus joining branch and gains coherence from the immediate context's sea, vessel, and motion sequence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The joining branch of focus word 2.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an assembled whole whose joined parts can hold and carry.
Supplies the broad unstable medium through which an assembled carrier must move.
Supplies the concrete carrier that makes joined construction navigable.
Supplies successful passage and turns assembled form into directed transport.

changed_reading.before: The Book's joined form is static binding.
changed_reading.after: Its joined form can be carried as a vessel-like structure that transports a reader through a shifting field under command.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Enrollment is less explicit than the plain evidentiary-record reading and should be qualified as a branch-activated extension. It remains anchored in the focus register branch and is supported by communities being summoned to their books and by the copying of actions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The register-and-cohort branch of focus word 2.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inscription of a name into a register or company and opens an enrollment reading.
Supplies each human collectivity as the cohort brought before its record.
Supplies the summons that calls each enrolled cohort toward its book.
Makes the context book function as a register linking persons with a cohort and record.
Supplies continuing documentary transfer as the register's maintenance process.

changed_reading.before: The Book addresses already constituted readers from outside them.
changed_reading.after: The Book may also enroll and locate its readers within a witnessed register, so receiving it becomes a matter of recorded belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The combat-encounter branch is far from the ordinary revelatory construction and must be presented only as an adversarial resonance. It remains anchored in focus word 1 and is activated by repeated mockery, summons, and overcoming power; it should never replace the primary delivery reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The contest branch of focus word 1, controlled by the source title at word 5.

activation_trace.role: Supplies descent into a face-to-face contest and makes revelation a summons to encounter.
Supplies the asymmetry of power that contains the contest resonance.
Supplies active derision as an adversarial response to disclosed signs.
Supplies the later summons that turns prolonged resistance into direct encounter with the record.

changed_reading.before: Descent is a one-way transfer with no encounter built into it.
changed_reading.after: At the far edge of the branch field, descent can carry a summons to decisive encounter: the Book enters contested space and resistance is eventually called before it.

strongest_changes: The rain sequence changes delivery from simple transfer into sustaining provision whose characteristic effect is revival.
The hearing and recitation sequences change the Book from available information into a diagnostic demand for following.
The summoned, truth-indicating, copied book activates a forensic record reading alongside the revealed-text reading.
The repeated closing titles expand the opening source description into a frame for cosmic order and exact judgment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's five roots remained unusually productive across the full context: delivery became rain, placement, reception, and severe arrival; Book became composition, decree, route, record, and enrollment; the paired titles became both a cosmic frame and a control relation between force and exact governance. The context did not force these into one solution, so ordinary and branch-distant readings remain explicitly co-present.
remaining_uncertainties: The definite focus Book most naturally denotes revelation, while the later forensic book may be deliberate resonance or only lexical recurrence.
The ecological revival mechanism is strongly patterned but its transfer from land to human reception remains analogical.
Prepared reception, bridle, vessel, enrollment, and encounter readings are anchored but should remain exploratory rather than govern downstream prose.
The closing repetition clearly frames the surah, but how specifically judicial the final title is remains open beside its broader knowledge and exactness senses.
